newsitem.title: USA: Coopers & Lybrand 1996 revs rise to $2.1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Coopers & Lybrand 1996 revs rise to $2.1 bln.

text.p: Coopers & Lybrand LLP said on Tuesday that net revenues for its fiscal year ended September 30, 1996 rose 11.1 percent to $2.1 billion.
Coopers said that all of its lines of business generated strong revenue growth in a market characterized by intense competition.
The company said it had significant growth in its priority industry groups and in its main consulting service lines.
The firm said its Business Assurance line of business grew 5.8 percent and advisory services within this auditing and accounting business grew 25.1 percent.
The firm's Financial Advisory Services practice, including corporate finance, reorganization and litigation services and services to the real estate and hospitality industries grew 11.3 percent.
Human Resource Advisory grew 15 percent and its Tax line of business grew 12.8 percent.

The company said that on an industry basis, revenue growth across the lines of business was led by services to high technology clients which grew 30.4 percent; information and entertainment clients 21.3 percent; government clients 17.7 percent and health care clients 16.4 percent.
